title: SMOK Nord Pro Replacement Coils
description:
Description
Specifications
Note: Sold individually. Please adjust the quantity to the desired number prior to ordering.
The SMOK Nord Pro Meshed 0.6ohm DL Replacement Coil performs best for 20W and is best for a DL vaping experience. Superior flavour and larger vapour, and is designed to be used with freebase e-liquid.
The SMOK Nord Pro Meshed 0.9ohm MTL Replacement Coil performs best for 15W, which is more suited for MTL vaping, consistently bringing delicious flavour and balanced heat distribution for every drop. It is designed to be used with salt nic e-liquid.
Available in:
Meshed 0.6ohm, Best 20W
Meshed 0.9ohm, Best 15W
